general.resetDescription: Deletes all data and settings from your account: accounts, categories, entries, cards, and preferences. This action cannot be undone — we recommend downloading a backup first, just above, under Full backup.
general.resetConfirmMessage: This action will delete ALL data and settings from your account and cannot be undone.
general.resetOnboardingOfferMessage: Your account was reset and is now empty. Would you like to set it up again with the AI assistant?

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.advancedHint: Opens the summary details in Transactions and the full analysis on Home already expanded.

modal.autoReserveLabel: Automatically set aside a reserve on income
modal.autoReserveTooltip: When enabled, every income received in this account automatically generates a transfer of a percentage of the amount to the target account chosen below.

accountTypes.emptyStateDescription: Click New Type to register one
accountTypes.sectionHint: Optional — just to organize your accounts

privacy.title: Privacy and account
privacy.policies: See how we handle your data in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and the <terms>Terms of Use</terms>. To take your data elsewhere, use the full backup or the CSV export above.
privacy.deleteDescription: Permanently deletes your account: all financial data, the assistant conversation and your profile. You are logged out of every device. This cannot be undone — download a backup first if you want to keep anything.
privacy.deleteConfirmMessage: Your account and ALL its data will be deleted now and cannot be recovered. If you sign in again with the same Google account, you start a new, empty account.
